name: marksyncr
description: Cross-browser bookmark sync extension with cloud storage

scripts.precommit: bun run lint && bun run build
scripts.setup:hooks: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && git config push.followTags true && echo 'Git hooks and push.followTags configured'
scripts.postinstall: command -v bunx >/dev/null 2>&1 && bunx @socketsecurity/socket-patch apply --silent --ecosystems npm; git config core.hooksPath .githooks && git config push.followTags true 2>/dev/null || true
